mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_job_posting.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO job_posting ( posting_idx, title, employer, description, pay, pay_type, work_period, work_days, start_time, end_time, time_negotiable, location, location_detail, latitude, longitude, sido, gugun, dong, subway_info, contact, benefits, user_idx, region_idx, category, deadline, recruit_status, created_date ) VALUES ( #{postingIdx}, #{title}, #{employer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{pay}, #{payType}, #{workPeriod}, #{workDays}, #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{timeNegotiable, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{location}, #{locationDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{latitude, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{longitude, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{sido, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gugun, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dong, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subwayInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{benefits, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userIdx}, #{regionIdx}, #{category}, #{deadline, jdbcType=DATE}, 'RECRUITING', SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO job_posting_image( img_idx, posting_idx, img_url, created_date ) VALUES( seq_job_posting_img.NEXTVAL, #{postingIdx}, #{imgUrl}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET title=#{title}, description=#{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, pay=#{pay}, pay_type=#{payType}, work_period=#{workPeriod}, work_days=#{workDays}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, time_negotiable=#{timeNegotiable, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, location=#{location, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, location_detail=#{locationDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, latitude=#{latitude}, longitude=#{longitude}, sido=#{sido}, gugun=#{gugun}, dong=#{dong}, contact=#{contact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, benefits=#{benefits, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, category=#{category}, deadline=#{deadline, jdbcType=DATE}, recruit_status=#{recruitStatus} WHERE posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT posting_idx AS postingIdx, user_idx AS userIdx, region_idx AS regionIdx, pay_type AS payType, work_period AS workPeriod, work_days AS workDays, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, time_negotiable AS timeNegotiable, title, employer, description, pay, location, location_detail AS locationDetail, latitude, longitude, subway_info AS subwayInfo, contact, benefits, category, deadline, recruit_status, created_date, hit_count AS hitCount FROM job_posting WHERE posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(location, INSTR(location, #{gugun}) + LENGTH(#{gugun}) + 1) AS dong FROM job_posting WHERE location LIKE '%' || #{sido} || '%' AND location LIKE '%' || #{gugun} || '%'

SELECT posting_idx AS postingIdx, user_idx AS userIdx, region_idx AS regionIdx, pay_type AS payType, work_period AS workPeriod, work_days AS workDays, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, time_negotiable AS timeNegotiable, title, employer, description, pay, location, location_detail AS locationDetail, latitude, longitude, subway_info AS subwayInfo, contact, benefits, category, deadline, created_date AS createdDate, hit_count AS hitCount, recruit_status AS recruitStatus FROM job_posting WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM JOB_SCRAP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND POSTING_IDX = #{postingIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOB_SCRAP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND POSTING_IDX = #{postingIdx}

SELECT jp.posting_idx AS postingIdx, jp.title, jp.employer, jp.pay, jp.pay_type AS payType, jp.location, jp.created_date AS createdDate, jp.category, jp.work_period AS workPeriod, jp.recruit_status AS recruitStatus, jp.work_days AS workDays, jp.start_time AS startTime, jp.end_time AS endTime, jp.deadline FROM job_posting jp JOIN JOB_SCRAP js ON jp.posting_idx = js.POSTING_IDX WHERE js.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY jp.posting_idx DESC
